## Version and environment

Release/hash, Windows/PowerShell/Codex, and relevant MATLAB/SATK versions if applicable.

## Reproduction and scope

Minimal redistributable example, exact operation/schema, expected and actual result.

## Evidence and recovery

Sanitized errors, receipt state, affected objects and recovery status. No tokens, Grants, private models, personal paths or production configs.
